title: The Fronde
summary: The English Wikipedia article "The Fronde", at revision 1370750172, opens: "The Fronde was a civil war fought in France between 1648 and 1653. The term comes from the French noun for slingshot, and was originally a derogatory term for the rebels." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q656186, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "series of civil wars in France between 1648 and 1653". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
